acceptance_criteria.text: Navigate to /activities/activity-processing, select Last Walk or Last Run, and click Start Processing -> step 1 Syncing activities starts and runs without a "name 'run_step' is not defined" error, and processing runs to completion (covers B1)

On /activities/activity-processing with Last Run and a playlist selected, click Start Processing -> all sync, playlist shuffle, elevation/smoothing, and segment matching steps execute in order to completion (covers B1)

At mobile viewports (360x740 and 448x875) on /activities/activity-processing while a step is executing -> the step status bar displays active progress that fills smoothly over time based on elapsed time and estimated duration (covers B2)

Profile backend pipeline execution times and database stored procedures (including resample_activity_to_distance and segment matching) -> evaluation summary identifies latency hotspots and safe optimization opportunities without breaking match criteria or replay smoothness (covers B3)
